name: potential-theory
description: Potential Theory — a compact set K as a grounded conductor, the electrostatic lens on logarithmic potential theory made literal. One pane shows K with its equilibrium charge (the equilibrium measure μ_K), the logarithmic capacity cap(K), and the Green's-function equipotentials g_K, plus — as overlays — the Faber-polynomial zeros and the Fekete/Leja points: three roads to μ_K. Two domain classes: EXTERIOR-MAP K (Schwarz–Christoffel polygons + closed-form disk/ellipse/segment/deltoid), where every quantity is an exact `=` pushforward Ψ(circles); and GENERAL K (smooth blobs), where capacity / Green / charge come from a log-lightning fit (`≈`) and the Green equipotentials are marching-squares level curves. Split out of 2D Electrostatics (ADR-0036); built on the shared @cas/* packages — @cas/flow (the conformal-transplant kernel: the exterior SC fit + the Net2D line-art drawer), @cas/faber (the Faber polynomials), @cas/core (the Householder-QR least squares behind the log-lightning fit), and @cas/ui (the shared browser shell). Convention-neutral core; conventions applied at the app edge.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
